- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. ### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Accept set and public surface: nothing moves. Right.** The diff is 8 files under `packages/spec/liveness/` plus one new changeset (9 files, +128/−112). Structural read of each ledger at `085ca6bc1c` and at the head, every leaf compared: 112 leaves differ and every one is a `note` or `_note` (api 22, datasource 24, email_template 14, manifest 1, mapping 7, object 15, query 17, webhook 12); 0 leaves added, 0 removed; 0 `status`, `evidence`, `proof`, `verifiedAt`, `evidenceScope` or `producer` leaves differ. Tracker numbers on the changed leaves: removed #13003 (114 sites), #11210 (5), #6345, #14691, #11408, #10329 (1 each), 123 in all; added 0 (no `#N` on a head leaf that its base leaf did not carry). At the head the only dead spelling left in the 8 files is `datasource.json:71` `#8874`, inside an `evidence` string the claim forbids touching (③). Author-shown text: the one reader of a ledger `note` is `packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts:390` (`authorHint ?? note`, authorWarn rows only); the only authorWarn row in these 8 files, `object.externalSharingModel`, is unchanged, so no author-shown string moves. `Clause-②: no` is right.

**(b) The anchors: real, reachable, and their own content decides each note. Right.** 11 distinct 9-hex shas stand on added lines: `9ee2dcfbd`, `8cb96ec41`, `93ea19bca`, `8f10a79f7`, `e2798fab7`, `b3a63d32c`, `f11fc61c5`, `905019b1b`, `15d58dbf1`, `aaacf1d5c`, and `c459da6bc` (pre-existing on the same lines; not new). `rev-parse --disambiguate` count 1 for all 11; `merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main` exit 0 for all 11. Per site: for each of the 123 dead-number sites on the base leaves, a 60-character window around the number was looked up in the anchor commit's own version of that file: 116 of 123 are present verbatim, so the anchor wrote the site. The per-file writing commit for #13003 is confirmed by the count of `#13003` in the file at the commit's parent and at the commit: datasource 0→27 and webhook 0→13 at `9ee2dcfbd` (batch 2; its subject names #13003 and its message names webhook.json's eleven bare-filename citations); api 0→21, email_template 0→14 and query 0→17 at `8cb96ec41` (batch 3; `Part of #13003`, stat lists the three files, message names api.cacheTtl's `cacheControlHeader` and query.expand's `2519+` defects the notes describe); object 0→15 at `93ea19bca` (batch 1; `Adoption batch 1 ... (#13003)`, the base's 14 are a subset, the actions note's later `/meta/object` edit by `9598f0ee7` left the RE-ANCHORED clause intact); mapping 0→7 at `8f10a79f7` (batch 4; its stat lists mapping.json). The 7 windows not at their anchor are the sites a later commit wrote, and for each the anchor's own content decides what the note now says: `e2798fab7` (subject `(#6345)`, message 'both hosts read the shared driver vocabulary', 'mongo→mongodb') wrote 'Since #6345 that table is also what both boot hosts read' into datasource.json itself; `905019b1b` (message `Part of #11210`, dated 2026-08-23) wrote 'Lines re-measured 2026-08-23 (#11210)' into mapping.json and is the only #11210 commit that touched that file; `b3a63d32c` (subject: retire the ten inert `RestServerConfig` keys, ADR-0049) rewrote `metadata_endpoints.json`'s `cacheTtl` row as REMOVED, which is exactly the 'different key retired for a different reason' the api.json note names; `8cb96ec41`'s version of api.json carries 'RE-ANCHORED (#13003)' on the `cacheTtl` row, so 'Anchors carried over from the cacheTtl row (re-anchored in commit 8cb96ec41)' names the re-anchoring correctly, while the carry-over itself was `e9fcd6bbd` (2026-09-06), which the sentence does not claim. Also read beyond the subject: `f11fc61c5` (message 'Maintainer ruling 2026-08-24 (declare — #10144 declare-or-rule-out family)') added the object.json `editMode` row itself, so 'the maintainer ruling that commit f11fc61c5 executes' is true and #10144 (200) rightly stays; `15d58dbf1` (subject `(#10329, ADR-0049)`, message 'liveness sub-walk note records the retirement') wrote the 'REMOVED in the 17.x line (#10329, ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove ...)' clause into mapping.json; `aaacf1d5c` wrote the `PluginPermissionsSchema` docblock at `kernel/manifest.zod.ts:29-35` ('Registered is not enforced ... REFUSES NOTHING today', measured 0 callers), on `main` today, so the manifest `permissions` note's 'the structured arm's zero is recorded apart (commit aaacf1d5c, the PluginPermissionsSchema docblock)' is true, and it is the pointer the claim's rider named. The 7 removed numbers answer 404 (#13003 #6345 #14691 #11408 #11210 #10329 #8874), #10144 and #12516 answer 200, controls 200/404. Mismatches found: none.

**(c) Form D, 4 clauses, tested against the tree. Right, with one witness note.** 'the review that accepted the re-anchoring sorts as OLDEST' (datasource `name`, webhook `_note`) and 'sorts as oldest' (datasource `driver`) replace 'the #13003 ACCEPT ruling sorts as OLDEST'. It is the construction slice 1 landed in dataset.json under record `5904102896`. 'the no-status-changes rule that re-anchoring ran under' (datasource `external.validation`) replaces 'the #13003 dispatch's no-status-changes rule': `93ea19bca`'s message says a falsified verdict 'is a re-classification under ADR-0049 and is reported on #13003 rather than executed in this PR', and `8cb96ec41` and `8f10a79f7` each say 'Nothing is re-classified', so the tree shows the rule. All 4 clauses sit in notes that also name their batch commit (form C beside form D).

'named GitHub issues that no longer exist, so a reader could not tell why a row carries its verdict': true (7 numbers, all 404). 'Each such note now either names the commit that made the decision or ... says what was decided': true, either/or, for all 112. 'The manifest ledger's permissions note also names the commit that recorded its structured arm's zero apart': true (b). 'The liveness/ ledgers ship in this package's tarball': true, `files[]` lists `liveness`. 'Note text only: no row's status, evidence, proof or date changes, and no schema, export or runtime behaviour changes': true (a). PR body: 'Slice 2 covers the datasource, api, query, object, email_template, mapping and webhook ledgers' true; 'Each note that cited a tracker number answering 404 now names the commit that decided it, or ... says what was decided' true (every note site; the one site left is an evidence string, not a note); 'The manifest permissions note gains the commit pointer the slice-1 review asked for' true (the claim's rider names `aaacf1d5c5`); 'Only note and _note strings change: no status, evidence, proof or date moves' true; 'One datasource evidence string still cites #8874; the next slice takes it' true as a plan from ruling `5905232957` on the card, and only a later PR makes it true in the tree; 'One @objectstack/spec patch changeset' true. PR title, either/or, true. The branch commit's message ('123 note sites ... Each now names the commit that decided it, or says the decision in words ... status, evidence, proof and verifiedAt is unchanged') is true; a squash landing takes the PR title and body. Dates kept beside the new anchors: '2026-08-28' beside `9ee2dcfbd`, `8cb96ec41` and `93ea19bca` matches their author dates; beside `8f10a79f7` (mapping `_note`) the commit's author date is 2026-08-29T00:39Z while the note keeps the batch's verification date 2026-08-28, which the rows' `verifiedAt` carry; the date is pre-existing and not a claim this PR adds. Compression, true of the commit: mapping `name`, `targetObject` and `mode` say 'commit 905019b1b re-measured them five days ago'; that commit's own mapping.json diff edits only the `fieldMapping` row, and the 're-measured' of the other rows is the line bound it introduced over every citation ('citations checked beside citations in range'), so the sentence compresses a gate run into an edit; the anchor is still the right commit and the only #11210 commit on the file.

For the seat's re-check: `d70428ae7` is unique, an ancestor of `main`, and its subject names #8874 ('in the spelling mysql2 accepts (#8874)'). Answered. Confirmed. (4) Worktree removed: not readable from the inputs and no diff consequence. (2) The mapping `905019b1b` wording compression (①d). (3) The OLDEST form-D clauses rest on the batch commit's own note text as their only in-tree witness, the same rung slice 1 took. (4) `main` moved two commits past the merge base (`4b4ee88fbc`, `7a09eee1b1`); neither touches `packages/spec/liveness/` or the changeset path, and the PR reads `mergeable_state: clean`.
